displayName: Survival Workyard Exterior Occupation Yard U3
gameplayRole: Woodcutting occupation storytelling: timber storage, log bucking, and splitting explain the path from felled tree to hearth fuel

reference.provenance: Original Crafted Realm concepts generated with Gemini / Nano Banana 2 on 2026-07-15

visibleFeatures: timber-storage rack with leaning pegged end frames, crossed braces, flat foot stones, ground sleepers, and retaining side rails
eight individually tapered, tilted sawn logs with proud pale endgrain faces, mixed bark tones, one branch stub, and an honest short-log gap
two hemp rope restraints wrapping the complete load, cinched over the side rails with knots and dangling tied-off ends
weathered chopping block: one continuous lofted hand-hewn trunk with root-flare wedges, bark striation, pale scarred endgrain top, dark angled cut marks, flush rim scar, and split chips
complete medieval felling axe embedded at a working angle: forged iron head, pale bit edge, split bruise and hairline crack, curved two-segment haft with swollen knob
pegged X-frame sawbuck with low stringers cradling a half-sawn log whose thin dark kerf slit follows the log's top cross-section, with a sawdust pile directly beneath
pivot: family origin on the ground plane; every object retains its own semantic root
facing: front is Blender -Y and exported Three.js +Z

placement.rule: objects sit against the court's south working edge, keeping the cardinal pond-door route clear (U3.06)

interactionOwner: Codex — WorldV2 authored interactions (walk-first scenery with right-click Inspect on rack, logs, block, axe, and sawbuck; semantic nodes reserved for later lessons)
collisionOwner: Codex — Workyard building definition; ropes, chips, and sawdust never collide

cardinalTurnaround.evidence: 12 per-object directional renders + 4 family renders, four 2x2 sheets, and four written per-direction PASS/FAIL reviews in scratchpad/workyard_exterior_u3_v1 (turnaround_*)
cardinalTurnaround.verdict: PASS 12/12 after two authored corrections: arc-profile kerf slit and flush rim scar

humanScaleRevision.rule: Every working surface serves the 1.85-tile adventurer; nothing competes with the lodge wall height
